issues.description: Global compute-table identifier name mismatch: the template dd.py declares the global ComputeTable instance as `_CT` but dd_simulation.py (template) imports `CT` from .dd (from .dd import CT, ...). The reference implementation (solution dd.py) uses `CT` (no underscore). This naming inconsistency causes an ImportError or undefined name at import time when students run dd_simulation.py against the template dd.py and blocks use of the compute-table API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the global ComputeTable instance name consistent between dd.py and callers. Prefer the canonical name `CT` used in the solution: rename `_CT = ComputeTable()` in the template dd.py to `CT = ComputeTable()`. Alternatively, update dd_simulation.py to import `_CT` (e.g. `from .dd import _CT as CT`) and update all uses accordingly. Apply the same name consistently in any other modules that reference the compute table.
